SIP::respond
Description
This command allows you to terminate a SIP request and send a custom
formatted response directly from the iRule.
Syntax
SIP::respond code <“phrase” <“header-name” “header-value”> >
SIP::respond
code <“phrase” <“header-name” “header-value”> >
Terminate current SIP request, send back a response with code, phrase
and header-name header-value pairs
